withheld.jp: 「上を目指せば神に辿り着く。そして神というものは現象だから」
withheld.en: Youko: "If I aim at the top, I will, eventually, reach God. And then, as God itself is Phenomenon..."
comments: This God is a single one and sits at the top, outside of time. At the most skeptical it could be said it's a monotheistic God completely compatible with the Christian one. Basically Youko wants to be God. Not delusional at all! -GHS

withheld.jp: 「人はいつか、物理の地平にたどりついて、神を目指すと思う」
withheld.en: Youko: "People will, someday, finally reach the horizon of physics, and set their aims on God, I think."
comments: It's so blatantly insane it almost bears no commenting. Considering the "horizon" (though metaphorical) of physics to be reachable is quite the failure of understanding what she's saying herself. Naturally, if God were to sit outside or above physics, not even reaching this horizon would allow humans to aim for Godhood. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「そのための手段は、おそらく一つしかない」
withheld.en: Youko: "The means for that objective are, I would say, only one."

withheld.jp: 「……いやぁ、全然意味わかんないわ」
withheld.en: Taichi: "...welll, I don't get what you mean at all, no."

withheld.jp: 「ありとあらゆる法則はそこにあって不変である限り、当初から許容された常識の範疇を出ず、つまり人間がしていることは物理を生み出しているわけではない」
withheld.en: Youko: "As long as all sorts and all kinds of laws exist in there and remain eternally unchanging, the order of common-sense acts permitted from the beginning is not the outset, in other words, what humans do is not what brings about physics."
comments: That's a contorted and twisted way of saying it if I ever saw it. And it supplements, but not entirely gels, with CCD0021's concept of deterministic world made by choices. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「……許されたことをしているだけ」
withheld.en: Youko: "...it's only what is allowed."
Youko: "That is the upper limit."
comments: "Do what thou wilt is not the whole of the law" is a less confused way of putting it. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「よって神になるための選択肢は、全知全能というベクトルにはない」
withheld.en: Youko: "Thus, the choice to become God does not exist on the vector of omnipotence and omniscience."
comments: That means you can't study yourself to Godhood, ergo God exists outside or at least beyond the ground rules of the universe. She's contradicting herself: that means humanity cannot reach this horizon of physics or set their aims on God, ever. Perhaps she thinks that's all she can do with the limited time given to her? -GHS

withheld.jp: 「現象化するしかない、という結論」
withheld.en: Youko: "Phenomenization and nothing else, that is the conclusion."
comments: This would make more sense if she defined what she means with the damn word in ways specific and understandable. CCD0021 is only vaguely clearer; best I can tell, she's talking about staying as a single point in history, ever unchanging. If my theory is correct, and the Cross World and its time loop are exclusively metaphorical, then Phenomenization is actually not possible and any attempt must be hallucination. Even then it fails: look at how leaky Taichi's 98 Game is, just this route. Even if phenomenization *appears* to be permitted, it's no more so than the flight that exists when one jumps off a building: it lasts only until the bottom is reached. -GHS
